## Merge authorization

## Checklist
- [ ] Scope and ownership are explicit.
- [ ] No self-approval; reviewer identity and independence are verified.
- [ ] Required CI and tests passed for the exact current head SHA.
- [ ] PENDING / SKIPPED / UNKNOWN / 0 Job are not treated as PASS.
- [ ] Domain/product acceptance is separate from technical review.
- [ ] No unresolved blocking findings.
- [ ] Merge authority and repository policy permit the merge.
